chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 130: Li Huowang Turns a God's Power Against Its Worshippers
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang seizes control of the ritual to summon Bashe in Chapter 130, forcing the Ao-Jing Sect elders to a desperate bargain: kill Danyangzi now, or lose everything.
og_description: Li Huowang hijacks a god-summoning ritual and holds a primordial horror hostage to bargain for his own survival.
twitter_title: Li Huowang breaks the ritual—and the sky—to make his own deal.
twitter_description: In a desperate gamble, Li Huowang uses Bashe's own power to force the Ao-Jing Sect elders to help him destroy Danyangzi.
